skill_name: Summarize the following text regarding online personal finance services.
workflow: Online personal finance services are designed to provide users with a convenient and consolidated way of storing and tracking financial data from multiple sources such as bank accounts, credit cards, and investments. These services can provide users with insights into their spending patterns, cash flow, budgeting and bill payment, as well as predictions about future income and expenses. This helps users plan for their financial future and stay on top of their finances.
